topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't help but think about the distance that will stretch between us, the endless miles that will replace the blocks we've walked together. I keep replaying our conversations, wondering how I didn't see this coming. It’s amazing how the simplest of things, like a smile or a casual joke, suddenly hold so much weight. I’m trying to focus on the plans we made to keep in touch, the promises to visit. But what I really want is to rewind, to the days when saying goodbye was just a temporary thing, not a prelude to a new chapter where we’re living in separate stories.
